hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer direct companion serial-line exchange smoke
hardware.tested_state: firmware rebuilt and flashed after animated QR reconstruction, exercised through companion serial-line exchange

procedure: Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and hardware smoke.
Built and flashed nSealr/esp32 firmware revision 0dda7d6 to the attached LILYGO T-Display S3 on /dev/cu.usbmodem1101.
Verified make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-capabilities passed with 39 verified exchanges before running companion-level serial smoke.
Used nSealr/companion revision b399ad0 nseal serial-line exchange to open the device port directly through Node serialport instead of the earlier pyserial capture path.
Ran nSealr/lab hardware_companion_serial_smoke.py in default companion-serial-line mode for get-capabilities with request_id lab-companion-serial-line-2026-05-11.
Ran the same lab smoke in default companion-serial-line mode for sign-event-disabled with request_id lab-companion-serial-line-sign-disabled-2026-05-11.
expected_result: The attached board answers a direct companion serial-line get-capabilities request and rejects a companion-generated sign_event request with signing_disabled. The companion exchange must validate the response against the original request before writing output.
observed_result: The companion serial-line get-capabilities smoke passed with response_ok true, method get_capabilities, signing_enabled false, and capabilities including sign_event. The companion serial-line sign-event-disabled smoke passed with response_ok false and response_error_code signing_disabled for request_id lab-companion-serial-line-sign-disabled-2026-05-11. Both runs used the direct companion serial-line exchange path rather than pyserial frame capture.
limitations: This is protocol smoke for the development USB/display signer path; it is not a production signing release.
This is not a new manual visual display inspection, physical button approval test, camera test, or QR flow test.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, key provisioning, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or real signing.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
